demos.constraints:
FORMULA Revenue [unspecified]: SUM(UnitPrice * Quantity * (1 - Discount)) computed from order line items, using the line item unit price at time of sale, not the current catalog price
  COLUMN: Discount is a column of "Order Details" only
  COLUMN: Quantity is a column of "Order Details" only
  COLUMN: UnitPrice exists on "Order Details", Products - qualify it explicitly
DATES: OrderDate mixes 'YYYY-MM-DD' and 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'; always wrap it as date(OrderDate) so the closing day is not dropped.
ENTITY GRAIN: group by the entity's id column (CustomerID, CategoryID, ProductID, EmployeeID, SupplierID) and select its display name.
REVENUE uses "Order Details".UnitPrice, never Products.UnitPrice.
demos.sql: SELECT s.CompanyName, ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice*od.Quantity*(1-od.Discount)),2) r FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID=od.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID=od.ProductID JOIN Suppliers s ON s.SupplierID=p.SupplierID WHERE date(o.OrderDate) BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' GROUP BY s.SupplierID ORDER BY r DESC LIMIT 1
demos.gold_sql: SELECT s.CompanyName, ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice*od.Quantity*(1-od.Discount)),2) r FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID=od.OrderID JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID=od.ProductID JOIN Suppliers s ON s.SupplierID=p.SupplierID WHERE date(o.OrderDate) BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' GROUP BY s.SupplierID ORDER BY r DESC LIMIT 1
